fusions.name: Royal Decree
fusions.desc: Brings down a rod of strands on a target up to 6 tiles away, dealing 30 radiant damage that rises to 1.5 times that at full reach. Bosses and elites take a further 5% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Imperial Toll
fusions.desc: Sends a strand at the first enemy it meets for 8 damage, at a cost of 5% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Standard Raised
fusions.desc: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 20% harder for 12 seconds, and fights with 1 more power while it holds.

fusions.name: Chancery Bearing
fusions.desc: Every ability you have comes round 8% sooner. Your armour rises by 5%.
